name: Alliance School of Law, Alliance University
cambridge_note: No A Level rule published. Site asks only for 10+2 or equivalent with 50% aggregate; confirm Cambridge eligibility.
entry: CLAT or LSAT India score, or the university's own AUSAT test, then shortlist and personal interview.
cost: BA LLB Year 1 (2027 intake): INR 3,63,000 fees; about INR 6,56,000 with single AC hostel.

name: Alliance University
cambridge_note: Not found. Only 10+2 from a recognised board; B.Tech needs Physics and Maths. Get written confirmation on A Levels.
entry: Own test (AUSAT, AUMAT or AUEET) or JEE Main, KCET, COMEDK, CUET or SAT scores, then personal interview.
cost: B.Tech CSE Year 1 (2027 intake): INR 4,63,000 fees; about INR 7,56,000 with single AC hostel.

name: Amity University Uttar Pradesh (Noida campus)
cambridge_note: Per-programme Class 12 %, e.g. B.Tech CSE 60% with Physics and Maths. Prospectus asks for a UGC equivalence certificate.
entry: Class 10 and 12 marks plus a personal interview for most UG programmes; SAT and CUET scores accepted.
cost: B.Tech CSE about Rs 6.5 lakh in Year 1 with AC hostel (2026); sponsored category about Rs 8.5 lakh.

name: Bannari Amman Institute of Technology
cambridge_note: Not named; TNEA treats it as Other Boards. Needs Maths, Physics and Chemistry with a 45% PCM average (40% reserved categories).
entry: No entrance test. TNEA rank on Class 12 PCM marks; management quota also on Class 12 PCM marks.
cost: Management quota 2026-27: tuition Rs 1,65,000 plus hostel about Rs 63,000, about Rs 2,28,000 a year (hostel third party).

name: BMS College of Architecture, Design and Planning (BMSCA)
cambridge_note: Physics and Maths at A Level plus one listed subject, 45% aggregate (COA rule), and a NATA or JEE Main Paper 2A score.
entry: NATA or JEE Main Paper 2A merit through KEA or COMEDK counselling; management seats by direct admission.
cost: Management quota B.Arch 2026-27: INR 7,00,000 a year tuition; hostel fee not published.

name: Dr. G.R. Damodaran College of Science
cambridge_note: Not named. Needs an equivalence certificate accepted by Bharathiar University; now issued by UGC, so confirm which one.
entry: No entrance test. Merit on Class 11 and 12 marks, then an interview for shortlisted candidates.
cost: About INR 1,75,000 for B.Sc Computer Science Year 1 incl. hostel and food, 2026 listing (third-party figure).

name: Dr. N.G.P. Institute of Technology
cambridge_note: Not named; TNEA treats it as Other Boards. Needs Maths, Physics and Chemistry with a 45% PCM average (40% reserved categories).
entry: No entrance test. TNEA rank on Class 12 PCM marks; management quota by online application to the college.
cost: B.E. CSE management quota: about Rs 1,96,000 a year incl. hostel, year not stated (third-party figure).

name: JAIN (Deemed-to-be University), incl. Centre for Management Studies
cambridge_note: Not found. Only a 10+2 pass from a recognised or equivalent board; no A Level count or grade rule published.
entry: Own JET test, then extempore or group discussion and a personal interview; B.Tech also takes JEE Main, KCET, COMEDK.
cost: BBA Year 1 about INR 5,00,000 incl. hostel, 2027 listing (third-party figure).

name: Kongu Engineering College
cambridge_note: Not named; TNEA treats it as Other Boards. Needs Maths, Physics and Chemistry with a 45% PCM average (40% reserved categories). Check management quota.
entry: No entrance test. TNEA rank on Class 12 PCM marks; management quota on Class 12 PCM merit.
cost: B.E. CSE management quota 2025-26: tuition Rs 1,65,000 plus hostel about Rs 85,000, about Rs 2,50,000 a year.

name: KPR Institute of Engineering and Technology
cambridge_note: TNEA treats Cambridge as Other Boards: Maths, Physics, Chemistry with 45% PCM average. Foreign route: 50% overall and in PCM.
entry: No entrance test. TNEA rank on Class 12 PCM marks; management quota direct with the college on Class 12 PCM.
cost: B.E. CSE management quota (2025 disclosure): tuition Rs 87,000 plus hostel about Rs 1,22,400, about Rs 2,09,400 a year.

name: Kumaraguru College of Liberal Arts and Science (KCLAS)
cambridge_note: At least 3 A Levels at grade C or above. Site still asks for AIU equivalence; now issued by UGC, so confirm which one.
entry: Own online test and personality test, then a campus day with critical thinking task, statement of purpose and interview.
cost: About INR 2,55,000 for B.Com or BBA Year 1 incl. hostel; tuition 2025, hostel 2024-25 (third-party figure).

name: Lovely Professional University (LPU)
cambridge_note: No Cambridge rule. B.Tech CSE needs 60% with Physics, Maths and English; ask how this is worked out from A Levels.
entry: Own LPUNEST test, or a JEE Main or CUET score for B.Tech, then online counselling and seat allotment.
cost: B.Tech CSE Year 1: about INR 4,59,100 incl. hostel and mess (2026 fees, no scholarship).

name: Mount Carmel (Deemed to be University), Bengaluru
cambridge_note: Not mentioned. Class 12 or equivalent with course subject rules; a board eligibility fee applies. Confirm with admissions.
entry: Own online test, document shortlist, then personal interview for most B.Com, BBA and BA programmes.
cost: BBA Year 1: about INR 2,05,000 tuition and fees for a non-Karnataka student, year not stated; hostel extra.

name: PSG College of Arts and Science
cambridge_note: Not mentioned; 10+2 or equivalent. Site still asks for an AIU certificate for foreign boards; now issued by UGC, so confirm.
entry: No entrance test. Merit rank on four Class 12 subjects (out of 400), then counselling by rank.
cost: Self-financing BBA about Rs 2,30,000 for Year 1 incl. hostel, 2025 fee guide (third-party figure).

name: PSG Institute of Medical Sciences and Research
cambridge_note: MBBS: Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English, 50% in PCB. Needs an Eligibility Certificate from the TN Dr. M.G.R. Medical University.
entry: MBBS: NEET UG rank through Tamil Nadu state counselling (government, management and NRI quotas). No interview.
cost: MBBS 2026-27: management quota about INR 17,14,000 a year; NRI quota about INR 29,14,000 (hostel and mess third party).

name: PSGR Krishnammal College for Women
cambridge_note: 2 to 3 A Levels plus 5 IGCSE passes incl. English, average grade D. Site still asks for AIU; now issued by UGC, so confirm.
entry: Women only. No entrance test; merit on Class 12 marks (out of 400) with Tamil Nadu reservation rules.
cost: Fees not published; ask the admissions office

name: RV University
cambridge_note: Cambridge is named as an accepted board; no A Level subject count or grade rule is published.
entry: Own RVSAT test plus interview for liberal arts and law; B.Tech through KCET, JEE Main or management quota.
cost: B.Tech CSE management quota 2026-27: INR 10,50,000 tuition and fees (per year not stated); hostel extra.

name: Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences (SIMATS)
cambridge_note: Not published (admission portal needs a login). MBBS and BDS follow NEET UG eligibility rules.
entry: MBBS and BDS: NEET UG through MCC deemed university counselling. Other UG: own SIMATS Entrance Exam.
cost: B.E. CSE Year 1 about INR 3,90,000 incl. hostel, 2024 fee text (third-party figure).

name: Saveetha School of Law (SIMATS)
cambridge_note: No Cambridge rule published. Needs a Higher Secondary or equivalent pass with at least 60% marks.
entry: Own admission test, then group discussion and interview.
cost: BA LLB about INR 3,50,000 a year on average, 2025 listing; hostel extra (third-party figure).

name: Sri Krishna Arts and Science College
cambridge_note: Not named. Bharathiar University asks for an equivalence certificate for study abroad (now issued by UGC); course subject rules apply.
entry: No entrance test. Rank list on Class 12 marks under Tamil Nadu admission rules.
cost: B.Sc Computer Science about Rs 1,52,000 for Year 1 incl. hostel, 2026 listing (third-party figure).

name: Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology (SKCET)
cambridge_note: Not named; HSC or equivalent with Maths, Physics and Chemistry at a 45% average (40% reserved categories).
entry: No entrance test. TNEA rank on Class 12 PCM marks; management quota on Class 12 PCM marks.
cost: B.E. CSE management quota: about INR 2,65,000 a year incl. hostel; tuition per 2025 disclosure (third-party figure).

name: St Joseph's University
cambridge_note: Five IGCSE passes incl. English and 2 or 3 A Levels at grade C or above. AIU equivalence if in doubt; now issued by UGC.
entry: Shortlist on Class 12 marks, then interview; own SJUET test first for some programmes.
cost: B.Com 2026-27, non-Karnataka student: about INR 3,26,000 first year incl. ladies' hostel and mess.

name: Sona College of Arts and Science
cambridge_note: Not named. Periyar University must accept the board as equivalent; programme subject rules apply.
entry: No entrance test. Mainly Class 12 marks; some programmes may hold an interview or test.
cost: B.Com Year 1 about INR 2,38,000 with top AC hostel; tuition 2025 (third-party figure).

name: VET Institute of Arts and Science (Co-education) College
cambridge_note: Not named. Bharathiar University asks for an equivalence certificate for study abroad (now issued by UGC); course subject rules apply.
entry: No entrance test. Merit on Class 12 marks, then counselling, document upload and fee payment.
cost: B.Com or BBA tuition about Rs 72,000 for Year 1; hostel fee not published (third-party figure).

name: Woxsen University
cambridge_note: Cambridge is a listed board. 55% for most programmes; B.Tech needs Physics, Chemistry and Maths at 50% each.
entry: Own test (WAT, W-JEET, WDT, WLAT) or JEE Main, SAT, CLAT and other scores, then personal interview.
cost: BBA or B.Tech Year 1 (2027 batch): INR 8,28,500 all-in with premium food and hostel plan.

name: Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras)
cambridge_note: A Level listed as equivalent. Needs Physics, Chemistry, Maths and 75% over five subjects or top 20 percentile of the board.
entry: JEE Main, then JEE Advanced rank and JoSAA counselling. Class 12 marks are only an eligibility gate.
cost: B.Tech 2026 admission: institute fees INR 2,56,804 for Year 1; hostel and mess extra.

name: National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli (NIT Trichy)
cambridge_note: A Level listed as equivalent. Needs Physics, Maths and Chemistry, and 75% over five subjects or top 20 percentile of the board.
entry: JEE Main rank through JoSAA and CSAB counselling. Class 12 marks are only an eligibility gate.
cost: B.Tech 2026 admission: about INR 2,48,000 for Year 1 incl. first semester hostel; second semester hostel extra.

name: Anna University (CEG Guindy, ACT, MIT Chromepet, SAP)
cambridge_note: Via TNEA as an Other Board: A Level Maths, Physics, Chemistry with 45% PCM average (40% reserved). Submit marks, not only grades; marks are normalised.
entry: B.E./B.Tech: TNEA rank on normalised Class 12 PCM marks, no entrance exam. B.Arch needs an aptitude score such as NATA. NRI/FN seats apply separately.
cost: About Rs 1.43 lakh in year 1 for B.E. CSE (Self Supporting) with hostel, 2025-26; regular seats cost less

name: Madras Medical College
cambridge_note: NEET rule: Physics, Chemistry, Biology, English passed, 50% in PCB (40% reserved). State quota needs a Dr. M.G.R. Medical University Eligibility Certificate.
entry: MBBS on NEET UG merit only, no interview: 15% All India Quota via MCC, 85% Tamil Nadu state quota (needs nativity).
cost: About Rs 68,073 a year for MBBS, 2026-27: official fee Rs 18,073 plus hostel up to Rs 50,000; mess extra (third-party figure)

name: Christian Medical College, Vellore (CMC Vellore)
cambridge_note: MBBS: Physics, Chemistry, Biology, English passed in one attempt, 50% in PCB (40% reserved), plus a Dr. M.G.R. Medical University Eligibility Certificate.
entry: MBBS on NEET UG rank only, with CMC's own application and Tamil Nadu counselling. Nursing and allied health: CMC's own entrance test, then tests and interviews.
cost: About INR 2,08,330 in the first year for MBBS with hostel, 2026-27; nursing and allied health degrees cost less

name: National Law School of India University (NLSIU)
cambridge_note: BA LLB: pass in 10+2 or equivalent with at least 45% or its equivalent in grade (40% SC/ST/PwD). No subject rule stated. NLS BA (Hons) needs 55%.
entry: BA LLB (Hons): CLAT UG rank only, through Consortium counselling, no interview. NLS BA (Hons): NLSIU's own NLSAT-BA. Foreign nationals: own test plus interview.
cost: INR 4,51,000 a year for BA LLB (Hons), 2026-27: tuition and facilities plus housing with meals; one-time fees extra

name: School of Planning and Architecture, New Delhi (SPA Delhi; also SPA Bhopal and Vijayawada)
where: New Delhi, Delhi (also Bhopal and Vijayawada)
cambridge_note: A Level accepted for JoSAA, but needs 75% in five subjects (no top 20 percentile figure for Cambridge). B.Arch needs Physics, Chemistry, Maths; B.Plan needs Maths.
entry: JEE Main Paper 2A (B.Arch) or 2B (B.Plan) rank, then JoSAA counselling. NATA not accepted. No interview or portfolio. Students abroad apply through DASA.
cost: INR 1,24,497 for the first semester of B.Arch with mess, 2025-27 notices; full-year total not published

name: Indian Institute of Management Indore (IIM Indore), Integrated Programme in Management
cambridge_note: Foreign boards may apply; no subject or minimum percentage in the 2026 rules. Strict age limit. June series results may arrive after classes start; check.
entry: IPMAT Indore (own test), then interview; final merit is 65% test and 35% interview. Board marks not scored. Foreign passport holders use SAT 1300+.
cost: Rs 7,04,000 in year 1 (2026-31 batch): course fee including lodging, plus caution and mess deposits; years 4 and 5 cost more

name: The University of Manchester
cambridge_note: Offers vary by course. Example: BSc Computer Science A*AA with A* in Maths plus a science; science practical must be passed.
entry: UCAS application with personal statement and reference, judged on course entry criteria. Medicine and Dentistry also use UCAT and interviews.
cost: About £50,239 a year for BSc Computer Science, 2027 entry: tuition £39,700 plus living costs; visa and health surcharge extra

name: University of Leeds
cambridge_note: Offers vary by course. Example: Computer Science BSc AAA including Maths, science practical passed, plus IGCSE English grade 4 (C) or equivalent.
entry: UCAS application with personal statement and reference, judged on each course's entry criteria. Medicine and Dentistry have the early UCAS deadline.
cost: About £44,239 a year for Computer Science BSc, 2027/28: tuition £33,700 plus living costs; visa and health surcharge extra

name: Taylor's University
where: Subang Jaya, Greater Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
cambridge_note: Rules differ by programme. Example: Computer Science needs A Level pass with at least DD, plus 5 IGCSE/O Level credits including Additional Mathematics.
entry: Direct online application; meet the programme's minimum entry rules and subject prerequisites. IELTS 5.5 or an English-medium pre-university course.
cost: About RM 113,008 in year 1 for Computer Science, Feb 2027 intake: tuition, one-time fees, cheapest campus room and living

name: Singapore Institute of Management (SIM Global Education)
cambridge_note: Set by each partner university. Example, University of London BSc Economics and Management: two A Levels plus three O Levels, O Level Maths C6 or better.
entry: Direct online application to SIM against the partner's academic and English rules. Degrees are awarded by partner universities, not by SIM.
cost: About S$47,005 in year 1 for the University of London BSc Economics and Management, 2027: fees, cheapest hostel and living

name: University of Birmingham Dubai
where: Dubai International Academic City, Dubai, UAE
cambridge_note: Same rules as the UK campus. Example: Computer Science A*AA to ABB with A in A Level Maths. Foundation route from CC. Predicted grades accepted to apply.
entry: Direct online application (not UCAS) with personal statement and reference; no interview or SAT. No application fee.
cost: About AED 239,038 a year for Computer Science BSc: tuition AED 156,718 (Sept 2026 entry) plus official living estimate; visa extra

name: University of Bristol
cambridge_note: Typically AAA or higher. Example: BSc Computer Science A*AA including A* in Maths (contextual AAB with A in Maths); GCSE profile rules also apply.
entry: UCAS application with personal statement and reference; each course's admissions statement sets how it selects.
cost: About £45,239 a year for BSc Computer Science, 2027: tuition £34,700 plus living costs; visa and health surcharge extra

name: Dublin City University (DCU)
cambridge_note: At least 2 A Levels plus 4 O Levels (or mixes with AS), all grade C or above, including Maths and English. Programmes may add subject rules.
entry: Direct application through the DCU portal (not CAO), assessed on grades converted to points per programme. No admissions test; places are competitive.
cost: About €33,850 a year (life sciences, 2027/28): tuition €23,850 plus the €10,000 Irish immigration living funds figure

name: Middlesex University Dubai
cambridge_note: Two A Levels at top grades or three at about BBC. IGCSE only means the International Foundation Programme first.
entry: Direct online application; no SAT, interview or portfolio for A Level or Indian board students. Offer usually within 48 hours. January and September intakes.
cost: About AED 124,557 a year: tuition AED 64,557 (2026/27) plus estimated housing and living; visa extra

name: Monash University Malaysia
cambridge_note: Score from best 3 A Levels (A*/A = 5 to E = 1). Engineering needs 10 (e.g. BCC) with Maths and a science; Psychology needs 8
entry: Direct application; offers on entry score and course prerequisites. CBSE 80% for Engineering, 70% for Psychology
cost: About RM 102,883 a year all-in for Engineering 2027 (tuition plus 6% tax, fees, visa, living)

name: University for the Creative Arts (UCA)
where: Canterbury, Epsom and Farnham (Kent and Surrey), England
cambridge_note: Typical BA offer 112 UCAS points (BBC at A Level) plus a portfolio and four GCSE-level passes including English
entry: Apply direct (free) or through UCAS; UCAS points plus a portfolio of 12 to 20 pieces, or an audition for performing arts
cost: About £30,339 a year: tuition £19,800 (2027/28) plus UK visa living figure

name: Curtin Singapore
cambridge_note: Minimum 5 points from 2 A Levels plus 3 O Level passes; BCom cut-off A Level 5. Degree awarded by Curtin University
entry: Direct or through an agent; grade cut-off plus English requirement. No entrance test or interview for BCom
cost: About S$56,480 a year: BCom tuition S$34,008 plus admin fee and living benchmark (fees rise yearly)

name: Dalhousie University
cambridge_note: Five academic subjects incl. two A Levels or four AS Levels, with programme prerequisites; no grade offer, programme average applies
entry: Direct online application; mainly on programme average (70 to 80%) and prerequisites. No SAT/ACT
cost: About CAD 75,361 a year for Engineering 2026-27: tuition and fees plus IRCC living figure

name: Deakin University
where: Melbourne (Burwood), Geelong and Warrnambool, Victoria, Australia
cambridge_note: Points from best three A Levels (A = 5 to E = 1); 2027 minimums e.g. B Arts 6 (DDD), B Commerce 8 at Burwood; prerequisites apply
entry: Apply direct or via an authorised agent; minimum score per course and campus. No SAT/ACT or entrance exam
cost: About AUD 67,910 a year for B Arts 2027 (tuition plus visa living figure); B Commerce AUD 76,510

name: EPITA School of Engineering and Computer Science (BSc Computer Science)
cambridge_note: No A Level offer published; needs a high school diploma with a strong maths and science background. Ask about offers before results
entry: Direct online application; file review of motivation, academic level and English. No test or interview on the international route
cost: About €23,650 for Year 1: tuition €10,450 plus EPITA's Paris living figure

name: ESSCA School of Management (Bachelor in International Management)
where: Angers, Paris, Lyon and other campuses, France
cambridge_note: No A Level offer published; a non-French high school diploma is accepted, with the last two years' transcripts
entry: Direct online application in rolling sessions; academic file review, then an online motivation interview. No written test
cost: About €23,785 for Year 1: tuition €12,500 (2027-28) plus extras and visa living minimum

name: ESSEC Business School, Asia-Pacific campus Singapore (Global BBA)
cambridge_note: GCE A Level accepted but no grade offer; a record well above average with steady or rising results is expected
entry: Online application in rounds; committee reviews the file, references and CV, then a 30-minute interview. SAT optional
cost: About €22,193 Year 1 fees (2026 intake) plus about S$21,600 living benchmark

name: Istituto Europeo di Design (IED Milano)
cambridge_note: A Levels meet the 12-year schooling rule (IGCSE alone does not); needs a Declaration of Value or CIMEA statement
entry: Direct application; admission test of academic record, portfolio or set project and language, then an interview. Places limited
cost: About €31,170 for Year 1: flat non-EU fee €20,800 (2026-27) plus tax and visa living minimum

name: King's College London
cambridge_note: Accepted grade for grade with UK A Levels; e.g. Computer Science A*A*A with A in Maths. Thinking Skills, Global Perspectives not counted
entry: UCAS only; grades and predictions, personal statement and reference. LNAT for Law, UCAT for Medicine and Dentistry
cost: About £56,661 a year: Computer Science tuition £42,900 (2027-28) plus UK visa London living figure

name: Le Cordon Bleu Australia (Melbourne campus)
cambridge_note: Bachelor needs Australian Year 12 with ATAR 60 or equivalent; no A Level grade table published, so ask admissions
entry: Apply online direct or via an agent; assessed on education, age (18 at start) and English. No test, portfolio or interview
cost: About AU$50,269 a year: Bachelor of Business tuition (AU$61,676 over 3 years) plus visa living figure

name: University of Nebraska–Lincoln
cambridge_note: No A Level offer; core subject units in maths, science, social science and English needed. A Levels at C or above can earn credit
entry: Common App or Nebraska's own application; formula-based assured admission, else committee review. Test optional, except some majors
cost: About USD 53,922 a year all-in for 2026-27 (tuition, fees, housing, food, insurance)

name: The University of Sydney
cambridge_note: Score from best three or four A2 subjects (A*=6 to E=1); AS not counted. 2027 guide: e.g. B Science 13 (ABB), B Commerce 17 (A*A*A).
entry: Apply direct online. Rank based on your A Level or CBSE score plus any course criteria; Medicine adds a written test and panel; Music needs portfolio.
cost: About AUD 93,310 a year (tuition plus living, B Science (Medical Science), 2027); Commerce about AUD 88,810

name: University of the Arts London (UAL)
cambridge_note: Varies by course. Many studio courses (e.g. CSM Fine Art, CSM Fashion) need a Foundation Diploma year too; LCF Fashion Design and Development takes 112 UCAS points.
entry: Degrees through UCAS (deadline 13 Jan 2027). Portfolio-led selection, interview if invited. Foundation Diploma is a direct application.
cost: About £45,271 a year (tuition £31,510 plus London living, Sept 2027); a Foundation year adds about £38,916

name: University of Wollongong in Dubai (UOWD)
cambridge_note: 5 IGCSEs at D and 3 A Levels at CCD for the 3 year degree; 2 AS or 1 A Level at D for the 4 year route. Engineering adds Maths and Physics placement tests.
entry: Direct online application on marks: A Level grades or a CBSE points score (10.5 for 3 year route). No essay or interview listed.
cost: About AED 147,509 a year (Engineering tuition AED 68,909 plus housing and food, current list); visa extra

name: Texas Christian University (TCU)
cambridge_note: No A Level offer or A Level page published; TCU reads the school transcript and curriculum rigour. Check with admissions.
entry: Holistic review: grades, rigour, essay, recommendations, activities. Test optional through 2028. Need-aware for international students.
cost: About USD 92,588 a year (tuition, housing, food, insurance and other costs, 2026-27)

name: Manchester Metropolitan University
cambridge_note: Course specific; e.g. BSc Computer Science BBB with a B in IT, Computer Science, Maths or a science. AS Levels not accepted; three full A Levels needed.
entry: Through UCAS (code M40) or an approved agent. Grades and predictions, reference and personal statement; some courses audition, interview or portfolio.
cost: About £32,039 a year (tuition up to £21,500 plus living, 2027/28)

name: Nanyang Technological University, Singapore (NTU)
cambridge_note: Good passes in 4 A Levels from one sitting (3 case by case, not for Tuition Grant). No predicted grades; results needed by 31 July.
entry: Direct online application, decided on actual final results plus subject rules. Interviews for some; international Olympiad medals help.
cost: About S$59,800 a year (Engineering non-subsidised tuition plus living, AY2026/27); S$40,600 with Tuition Grant

name: Singapore Management University (SMU)
cambridge_note: Good pass in at least 3 A Levels from one sitting. Teacher-attested predicted grades plus 3 AS subjects accepted. Maths needed for Economics and Computing.
entry: Direct online application (Nov to Mar). Results, SAT or ACT scores, then interview if shortlisted; Law adds a writing test.
cost: About S$60,067 to S$84,067 a year (non-subsidised tuition, fees and living, AY2026/27)

name: University of Bath
cambridge_note: Course specific and high; e.g. BSc Computer Science A*A*A including A in Maths. GCSE English Language or Literature at 4/C.
entry: UCAS only (code B16), deadline 13 Jan 2027. Grades and predictions, personal statement and reference; interviews only for some.
cost: About £43,489 a year (Band 3 tuition £32,950 plus living, 2027/28)

name: Ahmedabad University
cambridge_note: Two or more A Levels count as Class 12; no minimum grade stated. Subject rules by programme (e.g. calculus maths for Data Science). AICE Diploma not recognised.
entry: Holistic: school record, personal statement and interaction with faculty; portfolio for Integrated Arts. BTech uses JEE Main or GUJCET.
cost: About ₹8.46 lakh for Year 1 of BA, BSc or BCom (tuition, housing and meals, 2026-27)

name: Pearl Academy
where: New Delhi, Jaipur, Mumbai and Bengaluru
cambridge_note: Class 12 pass in any stream; no Cambridge rule and no equivalence rule stated. Confirm with the admissions office.
entry: Own entrance test (written test plus online interview with portfolio review). International applicants: interview and portfolio only.
cost: Up to ₹7.88 lakh a year, tuition only (BDes Fashion Design, 2026-27), plus ₹85,000 one-time fee

name: UPES (University of Petroleum and Energy Studies)
cambridge_note: A Level accepted as Class 12. BTech: 50% in Class 10, 12 and PCM (70% for Maths and Computing). Some may need a UGC equivalence certificate.
entry: Score based: UPESEAT, JEE Main, SAT, CUET or board marks, then counselling. Own tests for Design, BBA, Pharmacy and Law.
cost: About ₹7.95 lakh for Year 1 of BTech CSE (tuition and dearest hostel, 2026-27)

name: Chandigarh University
cambridge_note: No Cambridge rule found. B.E. CSE needs 60% with Physics and Maths plus one listed subject; check A Level marks against this.
entry: Own test CUCET (waived above 90% in Class 12 or JEE Main rank up to 50,000); JEE Main accepted for B.E. Merit based offers.
cost: About ₹5.6 lakh for Year 1 of B.E. CSE (tuition and dearest hostel, 2027-28)

name: Dr. N.G.P. Arts and Science College
cambridge_note: Cambridge not named; 10+2 or equivalent. Needs a Bharathiar University eligibility certificate and an equivalence certificate (now issued by UGC).
entry: No entrance test. Merit list on Class 12 marks, then counselling by rank (third party).
cost: About INR 2,01,000 for B.Sc Year 1: tuition (2026-27) plus single AC hostel (2024-25 rate) (third-party figure)

name: Kongu Arts and Science College
cambridge_note: Cambridge not named; 10+2 or equivalent with programme subjects. Needs a Bharathiar University eligibility certificate and equivalence (now issued by UGC).
entry: No entrance test. Merit on Class 12 marks and government criteria, then counselling; apply online or on campus.
cost: Fees not published; ask the admissions office

name: Mahatma Gandhi Medical College and Research Institute (MGMCRI), Sri Balaji Vidyapeeth
cambridge_note: No Cambridge rule. MBBS follows NMC: Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English, 50% in PCB. Equivalence now issued by UGC; confirm which is accepted.
entry: MBBS: NEET UG rank through MCC deemed university counselling. Allied health, nursing and BPT: SBV's own online entrance test (SBVDUCET).
cost: About INR 34,89,500 for MBBS Year 1, management quota: tuition, fees and AC hostel (2026-27)

name: M S Ramaiah College of Arts, Science and Commerce (Autonomous)
cambridge_note: At least 3 A Levels at grade C or better; programme subjects apply (Accountancy for B.Com and BBA). Equivalence certificate (now issued by UGC) asked for.
